help:
CFSail installer — Python 3, no additional dependencies.
Usage: python3 install.py [install|update|uninstall|restore] [options]
  --lang en|ko|ja|zh|es     Choose the installer and panel language.
  --web-root PATH          Use this verified Mainsail frontend directory.
  --backup-dir PATH        Keep verified original files outside the web root.
  --layout auto|native|standalone  Choose the integration layout (default: auto).
  --dry-run                Show the plan without writing any files.
  --yes                    Confirm explicitly for unattended use.
  --help                   Show this help.
No printer configuration, services or movement commands are changed.
dry_run: Dry run complete. No files were written.
cancelled: Cancelled. No frontend files were changed.
completed: Completed. Keep the verified backup at {backup}. Refresh Mainsail in your browser; no reboot is needed.
action_update: Update CFSail or change its language
action_uninstall: Uninstall CFSail and restore the original frontend
standalone_notice: This Mainsail build has no verified native integration anchors. CFSail will use a standalone panel.
unsafe_path: The path contains a symlink or unsafe traversal: {path}
invalid_root: This directory is not a supported, complete Mainsail frontend: {path}
unsupported_modules: The module path cannot be safely analyzed: {path}
missing_module: A referenced JavaScript module is missing: {path}
unknown_integration: An existing panel integration is not recognized. Inspect it before installing.
native_unsupported: Native layout is unsupported for this build. No files were changed. Use --layout auto for a standalone panel.
missing_asset: A required release asset is missing: {path}
invalid_asset: A release asset is empty, damaged or unrecognized: {path}
backup_tampered: The original backup failed its integrity check: {path}
conflict: This managed file has changed or conflicts with an existing file: {path}
locked: Another installation or an interrupted transaction holds this backup lock: {path}
invalid_choice: The value for {option} is invalid: {value}. Allowed values: {allowed}.
root_required: A unique Mainsail frontend was not found. Specify --web-root PATH.
backup_required: Specify an external --backup-dir PATH. Automatic backups are available only for recognized K2 paths with /mnt/UDISK.
unsafe_backup: The backup directory must be separate from the Mainsail directory: {path}
pending_transaction: An interrupted transaction was found. Review the external backup, then use restore to recover.
not_installed: No active CFSail installation journal was found for this directory and backup location.
yes_required: Unattended installation requires explicit --yes confirmation. Use --dry-run to inspect the plan first.
